main.label: About Me
main.title: Bridging modern component interfaces with robust cloud systems.
main.description: Informatics graduate specializing in Full-Stack Web Development and Backend Engineering with hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable software solutions in microservices environments. Proficient in Java, JavaScript (React.js, Next.js), and Go, with a strong foundation in cloud-based infrastructure, containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines. Possesses an analytical, detail-oriented mindset with a proven track record of utilizing telemetry data and collaborating within agile, geo-distributed teams. Eager to leverage technical expertise in API product development and distributed systems to drive high-impact digital products.
